dimension_notes_summary.cross_module_architecture: Import cycle detected: backend.rs -> commands.rs -> config.rs -> domain.rs -> lib.rs -> backend.rs (6 files)
dimension_notes_summary.design_coherence: app.rs is 1170 lines mixing UI state (Screen, ConnectionStatus), chat state (ChatState), agent state (AgentState), input handling (InputState), and slash command execution
dimension_notes_summary.package_organization: crates/openlibertas-core/src/ has 12 modules in flat directory - no subdirectories for related concerns
dimension_notes_summary.test_strategy: Only ~22 tests across entire codebase (6,458 LOC production code)
dimension_notes_summary.low_level_elegance: main.rs event loop has 400+ lines with deep nesting (event handling inside model loading inside chat events)
dimension_notes_summary.mid_level_elegance: App struct has 12+ fields with cross-cutting concerns (chat, input, models, panels, agents, mcp, theme, search)
dimension_notes_summary.abstraction_fitness: BackendRegistry is a thin wrapper around HashMap<ProviderId, Arc<dyn Backend>> with only 4 methods (new, get, default_backend, has_backend)
dimension_notes_summary.type_safety: Public structs Provider (6 fields), Model (3 fields), Config (3 fields), Conversation (5 fields), State (2 fields) lack #[non_exhaustive]
dimension_notes_summary.api_surface_coherence: get_server_names() uses get_ prefix - not idiomatic Rust (should be server_names())
dimension_notes_summary.ai_generated_debt: Some comments restate code: 'Spinner frame counter for animation' on a field named spinner_frame
dimension_notes_summary.initialization_coupling: Config::load() reads from filesystem at module level during app initialization
